gloss: facing mirrors; two mirrors placed opposite each other

definitions.gloss: facing mirrors; two mirrors placed opposite each other
definitions.explanation: Two mirrors positioned face-to-face so that they reflect each other, creating an infinite regression of images. Used practically to see the back of one's own head, and metaphorically in literature and culture.

examples.japanese: {合|あ}わせ{鏡|かがみ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{後|うし}ろ→後ろ：00683_ushiro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I check the back of my hair using facing mirrors.

examples.japanese: {合|あ}わせ{鏡|かがみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{無限|むげん}→無限：00296_mugen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: You can see an infinite world within facing mirrors.

examples.japanese: ⟦{美容室|びようしつ}→美容室：20238_biyoushitsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{合|あ}わせ{鏡|かがみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}がり→仕上がり：07432_shiagari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せて→見せる：01988_miseru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: At the hair salon they showed me the finished result using facing mirrors.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧ (to put together, to face) + ⟦{鏡|かがみ}→鏡：02190_kagami⟧ (mirror). The word describes both the physical setup and the visual effect of infinite reflections. Common in hair salons and barbershops.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {合|あ}わせ{鏡|かがみ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to look using facing mirrors
- {合|あ}わせ{鏡|かがみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to set up as facing mirrors
- {合|あ}わせ{鏡|かがみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧: the facing-mirror effect

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japanese superstition, {合|あ}わせ{鏡|かがみ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{不吉|ふきつ}→不吉：16952_fukitsu⟧ (facing mirrors are unlucky). Some believe that spirits gather between facing mirrors, or that looking into them at midnight brings bad luck. This motif frequently appears in horror stories and supernatural fiction.
